notes.title: Shadows of Zana Update
notes.content:
The player character and many game objects have had many improvements to particle and animation effects.

An option to adjust Screen Shake Intensity has been added to the Settings Menu.

Screen Shake Intensity now has 5 settings ranging from very light to very intense. Screen Shake can also be turned off completely. 

Some tilesets and backgrounds have also been updated.

notes.title: Shadows of Zana development Update
notes.content:
In addition to the facial expressions, a language select screen will prompt the player when launching the game for the first time. Language can be changed in the settings menu as well.



Some small fixes to bugs and typos have been fixed as well.



-SnuggleFry Games.

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE LOCALIZATION
notes.content:
Localization is now being worked on.  SNUGGLEFRY GAMES will continue to add localization moving forward.

Enjoy!
